descriptions.zh: 曾经同化我们整个物种的机械体自己四分五裂了。在我们身后是其统治和残暴的阴燃痕迹。[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]究竟是什么？我们又在其已经失败的计划中扮演着什么样的角色？
descriptions.en: The Machine which once assimilated our entire species has torn itself apart. Behind us lies its smoldering trail of domination and brutality. What was the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], and what role did we play in its doomed plans?
